notes.title: Release day - informations
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
Wanking Simulator will be released on TODAY. Wanking Simulator is an uncompromising game distinguished by a unique gameplay model and absurd humour. 

[b]Previously mentioned Wankhan DLC will be pre-included in base game version, so you don't have to download anything more. [/b] [u]And IT'S FREE.[/u]

[h2]Release time was set to 17:00 CET. [/h2]
Available in-game languages: 11 (English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Turkish)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1007840/Wanking_Simulator

[b]#ABOUT GAME[/b]
The game offers several different modes, including an extensive story mode. The story campaign consists of 6 diverse missions, which take place in the city of Gay Bay, a giant office, on another planet and inside an alien ship. 

You will be also able to play additional modes – challenges (5 missions), arena (fighting off waves of enemies), parkour (5 missions) and sandbox.

FREE Wankhan DLC gives players the opportunity to travel to the Wankhan region, struggling with a deadly threat – the FAPID-19 virus. Your goal is to recover the antidote from the villains and save human civilisation.

REMEMBER! Surrealism, absurdity and humour are three words that perfectly describe the nature of this production. The final version of the game goes far beyond the expectations that the title can bring to mind. The gameplay is highly varied, additional modes provide even more crazy entertainment, and many elements will surely be a surprise for players. All this is coated with absurd humour and political incorrectness.

[h3]Wanking Simulator is a title FULLY focused on humorous elements. [/h3][u]The only sexual act the players will encounter is the masturbation of the main character, but no genital organs or organic fluids will be visible in the game.[/u]

The game is based on completely absurd assumptions. Some of its elements may seem controversial, in a sense, but they have purely humorous intentions. Developers of this simulator certainly do not intend to offend anyone.

notes.title: Wankhan DLC coming (for free!)
notes.notes:
Well, Wankhan DLC is a real thing now, and it's coming for free in the full release!
What's it about, you might ask.

Winston travels to Wankhan after discovering a new virus: Fapid-19. 
Some bad guys have stolen the cure, and our mission is to get it back before they destroy it, and to save mankind from this terrible disease.
Also, don't get yourself infected in the process!
4-5 quests to complete, a huge, mesmerizing location; what else does the universe need from 
Wankhan DLC?

notes.title: Full Version Content
notes.notes:
Hello there, fellow gentlemen.

I would like to inform you all that the full version is still in work, but thankfully, not much is left for me to wank into it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35023805/ead0d42eb2496b0fb7394d6bbf342a2c64c5b0d4.jpg[/img]
[i]No idea who this guy is, but he exists[/i]

Full version of the game will include following things (and many more, that's not all):
[list]
[*] 6 story missions - each takes 5-30 minutes to complete; and obviously provides new, fun stuff
[*] 2 new game modes - [b]Wank to Live[/b] and [b]Challenges[/b]
[*] New in-game activities & items (weapons etc.)
[*] Global Score Leaderboard
[*] New in-game settings (for example [b]Funny terrain[/b] - makes moveable things react differently, they fly around like crazy, it's fun to look at)
[/list]

Obviously, those are only the things that have come to my mind at the moment, but there will be much more.
What else can I say, stay tuned.

notes.title: Characters Update
notes.notes:
Hey, it's me again, [strike]cuming[/strike]  coming in with another, tiny update on the project.

Lots of people have been asking about what kind of characters we will be able to play as - I'll clear it up right now.

So far you can play either as HowToBasic or Ricardo and obviously the one and only, Winston Gay. I couldn't get him to stand still and take a photo, his urge to wank was too big. Who else should I add? Donald Trump? 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35023805/baa0231b68967a4345baf23fb8cfeb44eddbeb07.jpg[/img]
[i]HowToBasic and Ricardo having fun together, as seen on the picture[/i]

Each character will have his own special sound effect (HowToBasic screams his head off for example), that we can use to get attention from NPCs.

I have also been adding some fine effects, to improve the wanking experience to the fullest. This is one of 3 abilities - a protective barrier that pushes everything away from our protagonist, thus making it impossible to reach us (the police can succ a dicc):

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35023805/65513f75bfa527eeac3edf2bc3ce7e7009d88c4b.jpg[/img]

And yeah, I know Ricardo should have USA shorts, I'll change that once I steal them from Walmart.
